description: Changes the venue’s name, legal name, address, phones, contact email, website or opening hours: what customers see at the bottom of every page and in emails. Only the fields you send change; send an empty value to clear one. The venue type, country and booking address cannot be changed here. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

legal_name.description: The business’s legal name, shown on the privacy page as the data controller.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours, one line per group of days (up to 7 lines), e.g. ["Mon–Wed 09:00–13:00 & 16:00–21:00", "Sat 09:00–14:00"]. Empty list clears them.

phones.description: Up to two phone numbers, the main one first. Numbers without a country code are taken as the venue’s country.

website.description: The venue’s own website, full address like https://example.gr. Used for the “back to site” button.

name: update_venue
title: Change venue details
